items.reason: The header precedes the status table and names the set, resolved runtime path, and binding kind.
Whole-set setup prints the header regardless of invocation location.
invocationOutsideRuntime suppresses the follow-up for subdirectories even though their paths differ from the runtime root.
Routing propagates recordedDefault to the header’s binding-recorded announcement.
The old conditional bound-checkout message is removed.
Single-task AFK execution prints the current checkout path without a Drain header.
HITL execution returns through runTargetedHITLGate before reaching printCurrentCheckoutLine.
Successful whole-set execution prints one green done result line.
Commit SHA or verified no-op detail prints beneath the done line.
The old Completed task line is removed, and result branches avoid duplicate endings.
Exhausted retries that fail the task produce one red failed result line.
Provider exhaustion preserves open status and prints the red left-open result instead of failed.
Quota parking prints a yellow quota-paused result naming the selected preset.
Interrupted agent execution prints the yellow interrupted result.
Blocked and Deferred remain set-level reports; executed tasks retain their own results.
Attempt failure narration, timing breakdowns, and exhausted-walk narration remain.
Header and result helpers use outputFor, preserving full plain text on redirected output.
Result styles use existing terminal color handling and honor NO_COLOR.
Header and result printing adds no journal writes.

scores.rationale: Clear, centralized rendering with useful tests, but subdirectory invocation and single-task HITL requirements are missed and untested.
